Join fellow symposium attendees for two evenings of conversation and connection in Perth. The Welcome Mixer on Monday is a relaxed start to the week, followed by the Symposium Dinner at the waterfront on Wednesday.

## Welcome Mixer

Enjoy a networking social evening with symposium attendees at the QT Rooftop Bar.
:::
